endorsements.label: Advanced ARM Exploitation
endorsements.description: "Hardware Hacking" is all the rage. Early last year (2011) we at DontStuffBeansUpYourNose.com debuted a talk entitled "Hardware Hacking for Software People" (see: http://bit.ly/pGAGlO ). The talk was a collection of experiences and simple techniques we as laymen had discovered/used over the years to perform very simple hardware penetration testing. We covered a range of topics from hardware eavesdropping and bus tapping to simple integrated circuit interfacing and debugging. The popularity of the talk, paper/slides, and video was surprising. People were really hungry for this stuff.
